6740.title: Sandboxed preview input and bottom anchoring
6740.rootCauseOneLine: Iframe wheel events do not reach the parent input listener, so the bottom-position keeper restores browser-chained scroll movement.
6740.proposedFix: Design a source-validated frame gesture attribution path without weakening bottom anchoring or treating hover as input.
6740.caveats: Verified in a real Chromium source harness, not a full application or physical trackpad. Automatic fix skipped because cross-frame input attribution requires a trust-boundary and policy decision.
